ADS301 DAISY CHAIN — multichannel silo telemetry
info:
Each physical ADS301 exposes multiple channel addresses on the same RS-485 bus.

For normal silo telemetry Node-RED does NOT require the ADS301 master address. Instead, one responding Unit ID from each physical junction box is used as the ACCESS Unit ID. Node-RED reads the ADS301 multichannel register block (0x1001 onward), sums the configured active load-cell channels, and publishes one logical silo value.

Logical identity remains fixed:
Silo 1 -> <gateway>_silo_01
Silo 2 -> <gateway>_silo_02

All channel addresses across both physical ADS301 boxes must still be unique when both boxes share the bus.

ADS301 multichannel commissioning instructions
format:
Commissioning — ADS301 multichannel mapping
Each physical ADS301 has several Modbus channel addresses. You do not need to identify or enter a MASTER address here.

Access Unit ID: enter any responding Unit ID belonging to that physical junction box. Node-RED uses it to read the ADS301 multichannel register block and sums the configured active channels.

Current test setup: with only the Silo 2 box connected, use Silo 2 Access Unit = 1 and Active channels = 4. Leave Silo 1 blank until its box is connected/configured.

When both junction boxes share the RS-485 bus, every channel address across both boxes must be unique.

name: Calibration instructions
format:
Calibration — whole-silo software calibration
1. Empty silo: select the silo and press Set Zero. Node-RED reads all configured ADS301 channels and stores their summed raw zero.

2. Known load: later, enter the exact known silo load and press Calibrate Known Weight. Node-RED calculates the scale factor from the summed channel values.

No ADS301 master channel is required for these two operations.
